summary: A stdio MCP server on Effect, serving typed tools and a resource over JSON-RPC to agent clients.
description: Build a stdio MCP server with Effect's MCP modules: declare typed tools, register a resource, and speak newline-delimited JSON-RPC over stdin and stdout. Vitest covers the pure parts; an e2e test does a real client handshake against the built server. The proving slice is a ping tool, an echo tool and one markdown resource, extended after the handshake passes.
seoDescription: A stdio MCP server on Effect with typed tools, a resource, JSON-RPC over stdin/stdout and a real client handshake test.
requests: build a stdio MCP server an agent can spawn as a subprocess
expose typed tools to an MCP client over JSON-RPC
serve a resource alongside tools through the Model Context Protocol
goodFor: a proving slice with ping, echo and a resource
testing a real handshake against the built server
notFor: an HTTP or SSE MCP server
a chat loop or model provider
